To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) RAdj can be acquired automatically from corpora; (ii) the acquisition of derivational rules is an important step in this process; (iii) the identification of RAdj can be improved by using a termer; (iv) RAdj and compound RAdj can be quantified and evaluated in order to be used for terminology extraction.

we have developed a method to acquire derivational rules from a corpus, that we have integrated these rules into a termer, that we have evaluated this termer on a corpus of French texts and that we have obtained good results.

we have successfully identified and extracted relational adjectives from corpora, that we have acquired the rules that allow to compute the noun to which a RAdj is related, and that we have quantified the RAdj and compound noun occurrences in corpora.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the automatic acquisition of a terminology which covers both the linguistic and the domainal aspects of the RAdj.
the automatic identification of relational adjectives and compound nouns which contain relational adjectives, their quantitative evaluation and linguistic precision.
the automatic acquisition of RAdj and the automatic evaluation of their informative value.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the RAdj are not only useful for terminology acquisition, but also for the automatic extraction of domain-specific knowledge.
the RAdj are not only a very useful tool for terminology acquisition but also a very interesting resource for the automatic acquisition of the derivational morphology.
the proposed method is able to identify RAdj with a precision of 80.6% and a recall of 80.2%.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the RAdj are a good indicator of the terminological content of the corpus.
the identification of RAdj is a good indicator to identify the naming function in corpora.
we have developed an approach for the identification of RAdj in a corpus, and for the extraction of their derivational rules.
The main takeaway from our work is that
RAdj and their compounds can be used to enrich the terminological lexicon of a given domain.
the identification of relational adjectives in a corpora is possible thanks to the use of morpho-syntactic information.
RAdj are very frequent, precise and informative in corpora of technical texts.
